_about: Public-domain Ralph Wardlaw (1779-1853, Congregational minister in Glasgow and theological tutor) for the Word Hoard: Systematic Theology (3 vols, Edinburgh 1856-57), Christian Ethics (1852), Discourses on the Nature and Extent of the Atonement (1843), Discourses on the Socinian Controversy (Andover, catalogued 1815), Lectures on Romans (3 vols, 1861) and Lectures on Ecclesiastes (2 vols, 1821), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

wardlaw-systematic-theology-1: Systematic Theology, ed. James R. Campbell, vol. 1 (Edinburgh: Adam and Charles Black, 1856)
wardlaw-systematic-theology-2: Systematic Theology, ed. James R. Campbell, vol. 2 (Edinburgh: Adam and Charles Black, 1857)
wardlaw-systematic-theology-3: Systematic Theology, ed. James R. Campbell, vol. 3 (Edinburgh: Adam and Charles Black; year OCR'd unclearly, 1857 or 1858)

wardlaw-atonement-1843: Discourses on the Nature and Extent of the Atonement of Christ (Glasgow: James Maclehose, 1843)
wardlaw-socinian-controversy: Discourses on the Principal Points of the Socinian Controversy, from the first Glasgow edition (Andover: Mark Newman; no year on the title page, catalogued 1815)
wardlaw-romans-1: Lectures on the Epistle to the Romans, ed. J. S. Wardlaw, vol. 1 (Edinburgh: A. Fullarton, 1861)
wardlaw-romans-2: Lectures on the Epistle to the Romans, ed. J. S. Wardlaw, vol. 2 (Edinburgh: A. Fullarton, 1861)
wardlaw-romans-3: Lectures on the Epistle to the Romans, ed. J. S. Wardlaw, vol. 3 (Edinburgh: A. Fullarton, 1861)
wardlaw-ecclesiastes-1: Lectures on the Book of Ecclesiastes, in two volumes, vol. 1 (London: Longman; Glasgow: Wardlaw and Cunninghame, 1821)
wardlaw-ecclesiastes-2: Lectures on the Book of Ecclesiastes, in two volumes, vol. 2 (London: Longman; Glasgow: Wardlaw and Cunninghame, 1821)
